summary: Establish a safe, observable plan for executing and evaluating “Real Harness Run 2” once its target, inputs, and success signals are confirmed.
scope: Confirm the harness location, invocation, environment, and intended test scenario.
Inspect existing run artifacts and configuration using built-in file tools only.
Execute the defined second real-harness run without altering unrelated files.
Capture outputs, failures, and relevant logs.
Compare observed results with the agreed success criteria and report findings.
out_of_scope: Installing or using external plugins, services, or tools.
Modifying production systems or external data.
Changing harness logic unless explicitly authorized.

acceptance_criteria.description: The exact harness command, inputs, and expected outcome are identified before execution.
Run 2 completes or its failure is captured with sufficient diagnostic output.
Results are evaluated against explicit success criteria and summarized.

required_validations: Verify the harness target and configuration from workspace files.
Verify generated logs or artifacts after the run.
Check the repository diff to confirm no unintended mutations.
